target.name: Barnard's Star
target.description: Fastest-moving star in the sky (~10.4 arcsec/yr northward). Propagated from J2000 to SPHEREx observation epoch.
target.scientific_notes: At ~10.4"/yr, Barnard's Star shifts ~4.4 arcmin between J2000 and 2025.8, and ~0.84 SPHEREx pixels per 6 months (~2.5 pixels over 1.5 years), creating a clear dipole in the difference image.
